import pytest
from your_module import ChemistLabService, SymptomService, PatientService

@pytest.fixture
def chemist_lab_service():
    return ChemistLabService()

@pytest.fixture
def symptom_service():
    return SymptomService()

@pytest.fixture
def patient_service():
    return PatientService()

def test_query_chemist_lab(chemist_lab_service):
    chemist_id = 1
    chemist_name = "John Doe"
    chemist_address = "123 Main St"
    chemist_contact_details = "123-456-7890"
    response = chemist_lab_service.query_chemist_lab(chemist_id)
    assert response['chemist_name'] == chemist_name
    assert response['chemist_address'] == chemist_address
    assert response['chemist_contact_details'] == chemist_contact_details

def test_update_chemist_lab(chemist_lab_service):
    chemist_id = 1
    chemist_name = "Jane Doe"
    chemist_address = "456 Elm St"
    chemist_contact_details = "987-654-3210"
    response = chemist_lab_service.update_chemist_lab(chemist_id, chemist_name, chemist_address, chemist_contact_details)
    assert response['chemist_name'] == chemist_name
    assert response['chemist_address'] == chemist_address
    assert response['chemist_contact_details'] == chemist_contact_details

def test_delete_chemist_lab(chemist_lab_service):
    chemist_id = 1
    response = chemist_lab_service.delete_chemist_lab(chemist_id)
    assert response == {'message': 'Chemist or Lab has open Prescription Requests - cannot delete'}

def test_add_symptom(symptom_service):
    symptom_code = "SYM001"
    symptom_description = "Symptom 1"
    response = symptom_service.add_symptom(symptom_code, symptom_description)
    assert response['symptom_code'] == symptom_code
    assert response['symptom_description'] == symptom_description

def test_edit_symptom(symptom_service):
    symptom_code = "SYM001"
    new_symptom_description = "New Symptom 1"
    response = symptom_service.edit_symptom(symptom_code, new_symptom_description)
    assert response['symptom_description'] == new_symptom_description

def test_delete_symptom(symptom_service):
    symptom_code = "SYM001"
    response = symptom_service.delete_symptom(symptom_code)
    assert response == {'message': 'Symptom does not exist'}

def test_patient_registration(patient_service):
    patient_id = 1
    patient_name = "John Doe"
    patient_age = 30
    patient_sex = "Male"
    patient_address = "123 Main St"
    patient_contact_details = "123-456-7890"
    response = patient_service.register_patient(patient_id, patient_name, patient_age, patient_sex, patient_address, patient_contact_details)
    assert response['patient_name'] == patient_name
    assert response['patient_age'] == patient_age
    assert response['patient_sex'] == patient_sex
    assert response['patient_address'] == patient_address
    assert response['patient_contact_details'] == patient_contact_details

def test_raise_consultation(chemist_lab_service):
    chemist_id = 1
    response = chemist_lab_service.raise_consultation(chemist_id)
    assert response == {'message': 'Consultation raised successfully'}

def test_generate_prescription_report(chemist_lab_service):
    chemist_id = 1
    response = chemist_lab_service.generate_prescription_report(chemist_id)
    assert response == {'message': 'Prescription report generated successfully'}

def test_print_invoice(chemist_lab_service):
    chemist_id = 1
    response = chemist_lab_service.print_invoice(chemist_id)
    assert response == {'message': 'Invoice printed successfully'}

def test_update_patient_profile(patient_service):
    patient_id = 1
    patient_name = "Jane Doe"
    patient_age = 31
    patient_sex = "Female"
    patient_address = "456 Elm St"
    patient_contact_details = "987-654-3210"
    response = patient_service.update_patient_profile(patient_id, patient_name, patient_age, patient_sex, patient_address, patient_contact_details)
    assert response['patient_name'] == patient_name
    assert response['patient_age'] == patient_age
    assert response['patient_sex'] == patient_sex
    assert response['patient_address'] == patient_address
    assert response['patient_contact_details'] == patient_contact_details

def test_update_patient_profile_negative(patient_service):
    patient_id = 1
    patient_name = ""
    patient_age = -1
    patient_sex = ""
    patient_address = ""
    patient_contact_details = ""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        patient_service.update_patient_profile(patient_id, patient_name, patient_age, patient_sex, patient_address, patient_contact_details)

def test_add_symptom_negative(symptom_service):
    symptom_code = ""
    symptom_description = ""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        symptom_service.add_symptom(symptom_code, symptom_description)

def test_edit_symptom_negative(symptom_service):
    symptom_code = ""
    new_symptom_description = ""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        symptom_service.edit_symptom(symptom_code, new_symptom_description)

def test_delete_symptom_negative(symptom_service):
    symptom_code = ""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        symptom_service.delete_symptom(symptom_code)
